text:
maria: customer reports sudden latency and billing spike for eu customers after a deploy. they say requests are routed to hosted instead of their dedicated eu pool and tokens cost doubled. sample req id: r-0a1b2c3d4e
liam: can you paste the request headers and any x-redwood-route info?
maria: pasted headers from customer: 
  curl -s -D - -o /dev/null 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate'
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-customer'
    -H 'x-redwood-project: acme-eu'
    -H 'x-redwood-preferred-region: eu-west-1'
    -H 'x-request-id: r-0a1b2c3d4e'
liam: thanks. their route metadata is missing the dedicated pin header in the telemetry we ingested. shows x-routing-decision: hosted-fallback and x-dedicated-pin-ttl: 0
alex: earlier this morning we rolled the dedicated pin GC change that aggressively clears stale pins after 10m. possible TTL underflow.
maria: customer timeline: traffic was pinned to dedicated-eu yesterday. around 08:12 UTC their app restarted and then at 08:22 a flood of requests started going to hosted, latency jumped from 45ms to 420ms, and billing notifications hit them.
priya: we already have a billing alert showing a per-customer hosted-usage surge matching that window. billing spike id b-44321.
liam: repro checklist i just ran against staging:
```
# sim repro: mark a customer pinned then expire pin and send requests
# set pin via admin API
curl -X POST 'https://admin.internal/v1/pin' -H 'Authorization: Bearer og-admin' -d '{"project":"acme-eu","region":"eu-west-1","type":"dedicated"}'
# force TTL to 0 in db
curl -X POST 'https://admin.internal/v1/pin/expire' -H 'Authorization: Bearer og-admin' -d '{"project":"acme-eu"}'
# client request
curl -v 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-test' -H 'x-redwood-project: acme-eu'
```
liam: with TTL expired the router falls back to hosted pool; because topology prefers closest available but hosted pool for eu is in us-west due to capacity, requests cross-region and latency spikes. we saw similar pathing in the router trace: router->hosted-us-west->model-node, and headers included x-actual-region: us-west-2.

maria: customer also sent logs showing x-dedicated-affinity: true but x-dedicated-pin-ttl: 0 — looks like affinity flag remained but the pin lookup returned nil. mismatch between affinity cache and pin store.
alex: probable bug: affinity cache is not invalidating when pin TTL gc runs, so the router's quick check uses stale affinity then attempts to locate dedicated pool, fails, and then triggers hosted fallback. the fallback doesn't clear the affinity header so telemetry is inconsistent.
priya: from billing POV, hosted fallback charges at hosted rates and customer saw ~3x token cost for that hour. do we have an automated credit path for obvious routing failures?
maria: customer asked for immediate mitigation: can we force-route their project back to dedicated-eu and reconcile billing?
liam: immediate mitigation options:
- manual re-pin via admin API (fast)
- bump pin TTL default from 10m back to 1h (requires deploy)
- add route preference check to prefer same-region hosted pool (shorter term)

alex: i can do a manual re-pin now. applying:
```
curl -X POST 'https://admin.internal/v1/pin' -H 'Authorization: Bearer og-admin' -d '{"project":"acme-eu","region":"eu-west-1","type":"dedicated","ttl":3600}'
```
deploy-bot: pin applied by alex at 2026-03-17T09:55:12Z (deploy id d-7821)
maria: after manual pin, customer confirms requests are back to dedicated and p95 latency back to ~60ms.
liam: followups:
- alex to open infra PR to ensure affinity cache invalidation on GC and to log a metric when affinity/pin mismatch occurs
- infra to add a router-sanity check so hosted fallback also clears affinity telemetry to avoid billing attribution issues
- billing to propose a one-time customer credit for obvious routing misroutes (priya)
- oncall to add alert when a project shows hosted-traffic > 50% while having recent dedicated allocations

alex: i created infra ticket INF-9987 and pushed a small patch to invalidate affinity on pin GC. will open PR for longer fix.

priya: will draft credit memo and route to ops for approval. need exact token counts from router logs.

sre-bot: alert created: routed-hosted-while-dedicated > threshold for project acme-eu at 1798765300
maria: assigning follow-ups: alex (infra), liam (oncall), priya (billing). putting customer on a high-touch thread and sending them timeline + repro steps.
liam: also adding a temporary mitigation in router: if x-dedicated-affinity:true and pin lookup nil, prefer local dedicated region until GC completes. short-term config patch rolling now.
alex: rolling config change to router at 2026-03-17T10:02:00Z (roll id r-4439)
maria: closing loop with customer. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
